title: Embermaw: The Brand, No Healer
rules_text: An evaluation Encounter: the Brand trial with Maren's seat removed, so the no-healer-clear measurement has its control arm. Same Boss, same programs, same seed — the only delta is that nobody can strike a Sear from the record. Never shipped to players; it exists to be measured against the two-seat trial (D-082).
enrage_text: Enrage: the brand finishes what the blows started.

escalation_thresholds.title: Deeper Burn
escalation_thresholds.rules_text: The western edge of the arena burns away for good.
